details.playable: From a planet with two lanes carrying the same commodity (each with a ship), a storage row offers 'Split half and half' or 'Split 3/4 and 1/4'. Click the first destination, then the second. The first gets 1/2 or 3/4 of the source stock per cycle, the second the rest.
how_to_try: Start a game, buy ships and make two routes from Tillam (food) to two other planets in system 1.
Select Tillam, press 'Split 3/4 and 1/4' on the Food storage row, click the first destination, then the second.
The notice reads '<first> 3/4, <second> 1/4'. Next cycle the first lane moves a full ship load and the second lane is held to 1/4 of the stock while stock is short.
